command: Love your neighbor as yourself.
Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord
let us love one another
Come, follow Me,
Do not judge, or you will be judged.
do not worry about your life
Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!
Do not let your hearts be troubled.
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another
Put on the full armor of God
Rejoice in the Lord always.
Be anxious for nothing
Do not be conformed to this world
Do not repay anyone evil for evil.
serve one another in love.
Carry one another’s burdens
Do not let the sun set upon your anger
be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
Do not lie to one another
clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else.
Devote yourselves to prayer
Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence
let us run with endurance the race set out for us
Let us fix our eyes on Jesus
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only.
Draw near to God
be holy in all you do
Treat everyone with high regard
let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth
Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
Repent and believe in the gospel!
Guard yourselves against every form of greed
Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought
Be devoted to one another in brotherly love.
Bless those who persecute you.
Do not avenge yourselves
If your enemy is hungry, feed him
walk by the Spirit
Let us not grow weary in well-doing
let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
Be imitators of God
Walk as children of light
take up the shield of faith
Pray in the Spirit at all times
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
Keep yourself pure.
flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness
Fight the good fight of the faith.
Make every effort to present yourself approved to God
